title: Strict integral exchange equals reindexing before reconstruction
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $g:Y'\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be an isomorphism of underlying schemes, with Cartesian pullback $f':X'\to Y'$ and $g':X'\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]; $g,g'$ need not be $k$-linear. Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow pY)$ and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with induced isomorphism $\bar g:\overline X'\to\overline X$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use integral coefficients $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi_E)$, $P_n=A/I^n$, the completed coefficient sheaves $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$, and the actual strict-tower construction of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map]. Let $K$ belong to its derived-complete domain, and put $M=j_!K$; require the complete objects and intermediate operations specified by that definition. Write $G_u=u^{-1}$ with its canonical completed coefficient identification [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. In the notation of that definition, $e_M:Lg^*Rp_*M\to Rp'_*L\bar g^*M$ is the ambient ringed mate, $\mathcal R_T(F)=\Delta F\otimes^L_{\Delta A_T}Q_{T,\bullet}$, $Q_{T,\bullet}=((P_n)_T)_n$, and $H,H'$ are its specified projection-mate and pullback/reduction isomorphisms. Thus
$$B_\bullet=G_gRp_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}\mathcal R_{\overline X}(M),\quad D_\bullet=Rp'_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}G_{\bar g}\mathcal R_{\overline X}(M),\quad v_\bullet=H'\mathcal R_{Y'}(e_M)H^{-1}:B_\bullet\to D_\bullet.$$
If $r_\bullet:B_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}D_\bullet$ denotes the diagram-site direct-image reindexing comparison $G_gRp_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}\simeq Rp'^{\operatorname{Tow}}_*G_{\bar g}$ of [lem-pur-isomorphism-completed-reduction-reindexing], evaluated at $\mathcal R_{\overline X}(M)$, then
$$r_\bullet H=H'\mathcal R_{Y'}(e_M),\qquad v_\bullet=r_\bullet$$
as morphisms in $D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y'))$, before $R\lim$. These equalities use the specified $H,H'$ and all strict transitions, rather than only equality of individual evaluations.

Under the quotient-projection identifications $Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}\cong G_u$ on derived $I$-complete objects of [lem-pur-isomorphism-completed-reduction-reindexing], for $u=g,\bar g,g'$, the proper completed factor $c_{p',T}^{-1}R\lim(v_\bullet)s$ of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map] is the ordinary completed-ring direct-image reindexing comparison $r_M:G_gRp_*M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp'_*G_{\bar g}M$ of that lemma, with precisely the direct-image/limit comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. The completed open factor of [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison] becomes the unit-normalized reindexing $\beta_K:G_{\bar g}j_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}j'_!G_{g'}K$, whose inverse is the $j'_!\dashv j'^{-1}$ transpose of $G_{g'}K\to G_{g'}j^{-1}j_!K\cong j'^{-1}G_{\bar g}j_!K$. Therefore $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp},c}_!=Rp'_*(\beta)r_{j_!-}$ as natural transformations on this domain.

Identity and successive isomorphism base changes, vertical composition and integral reduction commute with these maps. For vertical composition let $h_0:Y\to Z$ be a further separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $u:Z'\xrightarrow{\sim}Z$ an underlying-scheme isomorphism whose pullback to $Y$ is $g$, and choose a compatible tower of compactifications of $f,h_0,h_0f$ [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower] and its base change along $u$. Their identity, horizontal-pasting, vertical-interchange and reduction squares are equalities of the actual strict-tower transformations before $R\lim$, using the canonical proper/open maps of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus] and the coefficient comparisons of [lem-fix-operation-reduction]; their images under $R\lim$ give the same equalities for the specified completed exchange. In asserting vertical composition through comparison isomorphisms retain the compatible etale-origin witnesses and bounded domains of [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-composition-pasting-coherence].

proof.text: Obtain strict mate normalization, horizontal and vertical equations from lem-pur-integral-strict-calculus, strict reduction squares from lem-pur-integral-strict-reduction, and their completed images from lem-pur-integral-completed-coherence. These are separate proper parts of the original conjunction.

The proper and support normalization predicates and the reindexing exchange are those of def-pur-strict-integral-exchange-data. On j!K apply the already proved strict completedExchange_mate helper from strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization. Its ringed square is definitionally purReindexingRingedSquare. Expanding towerV prime and canceling H with its inverse proves r H = R(e) H prime with the actual H and H prime. The actual proper completed unit equation is completedExchange_unit, and its ambient integralExchange is definitionally purReindexingDerivedMate. The geometric input normalization supplies exactly the three invertible quotient units and ordinary open beta identification.

Apply cbcDatumCompletedExchange_unit and compose its equality with the supplied ordinary-open beta identification; this proves the actual completed open unit square. Obtain only the final total square from lem-pur-integral-total-unit-equation. Assemble these with the fully proved proper normalization, the input units and the strict/reduction/completed clauses.

proof_origin.reason: Reuse the existing proved strict mate helper and both completed-unit equations. This proves the proper identities and two-factor assembly while splitting the remaining strict/reduction/reconstruction steps into four strictly smaller statements.
